build_trainer_optimizer: build an SGD optimizer with gradient clipping and custom learning rate factors for CSE features and embeddings
build_train_loader: build a combined training data loader with optional inference-based loaders and sample counting for DensePose datasets
build_evaluator: build a DensePose COCO evaluator with optional mesh alignment evaluation and embedder support for a given dataset
test_model: test a DensePose model on configured test datasets with optional custom evaluators and distributed inference support
test_with_TTA: test a DensePose model with test-time augmentation using configured transforms and evaluators on test datasets
